title: Uniform Hiding and Two Routes to Relative Accuracy in Gaussian Boson Sampling
summary: Gaussian boson sampling requires control of how closely finite optical matrices follow Gaussian reference laws. We prove an explicit total variation bound of order $N^2/M$ between a rescaled Haar transpose Gram block and its Gaussian transpose Gram counterpart, where $N$ is the detected photon count and $M$ is the number of optical modes. The bound establishes quantitative product hiding uniformly over every number of squeezed inputs.
